design: Successful creation supply is conserved subject to terminal capacity and zero self-assist. Receiving propensity is a soft allocation prior rather than a cap on team creation. Global alpha from 2022-25 fresh-FGA actor choices; global beta from assisted-make passer choices conditional on receiver. Source lineup total demand conserved. No target player names, OVR/on-off ranking fit or positional bonus. Third variant enables source-centered long context. Diagnostic single seed, not adoption.
